description: Build a deterministic TouchDesigner scaffold for YOLO-style object tracking. Creates source input, backend receiver placeholder, detections DAT, stable tracks_out CHOP channels, annotated_out TOP, and setup notes. Live detection requires an external detector or validated TouchDesigner Python ONNX runtime.

active.description: Start live receiver operators active. Default is off until validation.

backend.description: Detection transport or runtime scaffold to build.

class_filter.description: Optional class names the external detector or ONNX postprocess should keep.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum detection confidence expected from the detector or postprocess.

input_top_path.description: Optional source TOP path pulled into the container through a Select TOP.

max_objects.description: Maximum tracked object slots exposed as stable CHOP channels.

model_path.description: ONNX model path documented by onnx_script mode.

name.description: Container name for the tracker scaffold under parent_path.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP that will receive the YOLO/ONNX tracker container.

server_url.description: External WebSocket detector URL used by external_websocket mode.

name: create_yolo_onnx_tracker
title: Create YOLO ONNX tracker scaffold
